# usecase fixtures

`usecase-beta` follows the Mermaid use case diagram documentation
(https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/usecase.html), MIT licensed,
© Knut Sveidqvist and contributors; ondine's documentation for the type was
read for reference only.

- `boundaries.mmd`, `relations.mmd`, `actors-notes.mmd` and `complete.mmd`
  follow the documentation's examples.
- `cjk-long.mmd` is written for this crate: CJK labels, a long label,
  quoted declarations and a multi-line markdown label.
